messages:
Ravi (Finance): Flagging a settlement mismatch for reseller 'VertexChannels' on the Apr monthly settlement. AWS reported a pricing band change retroactive to Mar 20 that reduced their per-unit price, but our ingestion applied it only prospectively. Partner says they were overcharged ~7k across Mar-Apr.
Clara (Billing Ops): What's the delta breakdown? I can pull settlement files and check our price history table.
Ravi (Finance): Quick summary:
```
period,reported_settlement,our_billing,delta_usd
2026-03,18,400.00,19,800.00,-1,400.00
2026-04,22,000.00,25,100.00,-3,100.00
TOTAL,,40,400.00,44,900.00,-4,500.00
```
Delta = $4,500 overcharge. AWS case 03-783900 opened for pricing band correction.
Megan (Accounting): For >$2k we need manager sign-off to issue provisional credit. Accounting prefers issuing an internal credit memo tagged 'pending AWS pricing adj' and book to contra-revenue 4230 with reversing entry template.
Owen (Partner Success): Partner wants a corrective credit on their May invoice rather than waiting for AWS. Theyre worried collections will flag the invoice. Happy to confirm in writing if we can do provisional credit.
aws-marketplace-bot: Automated notice: AWS pricing band change detected for account vertex-channels on settlement date 2026-03-20. Support case 03-783900 opened; expected 5-10 business days.
Clara (Billing Ops): I can backfill our billing run to apply the corrected band and produce an adjusted invoice, but we should not release it until Finance & Accounting sign off on provisional treatment.
Ravi (Finance): Proposal: provisional credit $4,500 to be applied to May invoice, attach AWS case & partner ack, add 10-business-day follow-up. Approve provisional credit up to $5k?
Megan (Accounting): Approve contingent on manager sign-off and GL tagging. I'll prepare the reversing journal template.
Ravi (Finance): Created FIN ticket FIN-3350 and attached settlement exports + partner email: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3350. Added automated reminder in 10 business days.
Owen (Partner Success): Sent partner confirmation: "We will apply a provisional credit of $4,500 to your May invoice while AWS investigates. If AWS issues a pricing correction, we'll finalize records accordingly." Partner replied: "Thanks, that works. Please share the adjusted invoice when ready."
Megan (Accounting): Logged provisional credit to contra-revenue 4230 and will route for manager approval.
Ravi (Finance): Manager approved provisional credit (Lina +1). Applying offset and closing loop. Will reverse if AWS provides a different resolution. Thread closed. :white_check_mark:
